name: Thai Green Curry Chicken with Snap Peas, Bell Pepper, Cilantro & Rice

ingredients.name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place chickens on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces; place in a large bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (850 g) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Place broth, coconut milk, curry paste, fish sauce, and salt in a large pot; stir to combine. Bring the curry to a simmer over medium heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ (398 ml) cans coconut milk
⅓ cup Thai curry paste, green
1 tbsp fish sauce
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the curry heats up, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ limes
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the chicken along with the snap peas.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: Once the curry is simmering, add chicken and veggies to the pot; stir to combine. Return curry to a simmer and continue to cook until chicken is warmed through and veggies are tender, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut limes into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the curry, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide rice and curry between plates or bowls; serve with lime wedges for squeezing. Enjoy!
